layout_dets.text: Locating Blood Vessels in Retinal Images

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by Piece-wise Threshold Probing of a Matched Filter Response

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Adam Hoover, Ph.D.*, Valentina Kouznetsova, Ph.D.*, Michael Goldbaum, M.D.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: +Electrical and Computer Engineering Department

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Department of Ophthalmology

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Key words: medical image processing, retinal imaging, blood vessel segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ABSTRACT

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We describe an automated method to locate and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: outline blood vessels in images of the ocular fundus.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Such a tool should prove useful to eyecare specialists

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for purposes of patient screening, treatment

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: evaluation, and clinical study. Our method differs from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: previously known methods in that it uses local and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: global vessel features cooperatively to segment the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vessel network. A comparison of our method against

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hand-labeled ground truth segmentations of five

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: images yielded 65% sensitivity and 81% specificity. A

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: previously known technique yielded 69% sensitivity

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and 63% specificity. For a baseline, we also compared

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the ground truth against a second hand labeling,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: yielding 80% sensitivity and 90% specificity. These

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: numbers indicate our method improves upon the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: previously known technique, but that further

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: improvement is still possible.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: INTRODUCTION

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Blood vessel appearance is an important indicator

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for many diagnoses, including diabetes, hypertension,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and arteriosclerosis. Vessels and arteries have many

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: observable features, including diameter, color,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tortuosity (relative curvature), and opacity

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (reflectivity). Artery-vein crossings and patterns of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: small vessels can also serve as diagnostic indicators.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: An accurate delineation of the boundaries of blood

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vessels makes precise measurements of these features

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: possible. These measurements may then be applied to a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: variety of tasks, including diagnosis, treatment

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: evaluation, and clinical study.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We describe an automated method to locate and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: outline blood vessels in images of the ocular fundus.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: With this tool, eyecare specialists can potentially

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: screen larger populations for vessel abnormalities.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Precise measurements may be more easily recorded,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for instance for evaluation of treatment or for clinical

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: study. Observations based upon such a tool would also

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: be more systematically reproduceable.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Previous methods to segment blood vessels

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: automatically have concentrated primarily on their

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: local attributes. Vessels may be characterized by the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: expected color (reddish), shape (curvilinear), gradient

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (strength of boundary), and contrast (with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: background). Unfortunately, this description is not

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: exclusive. For suitable ranges of these attributes, other

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image manifestations, such as the boundaries of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: optic nerve and some hemorrhages and lesions, can

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: exhibit the same local attributes as vessels.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Figure 1 shows an example retinal image, along

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with an image showing the result of the matched filter

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: convolution described in [1]. The strength of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matched filter response (MFR) is coded in greyscale:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the darker a pixel, the stronger the response. Notice

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that the strong responses in the center of the MFR

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image, which are obviously not vessel, are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: unfortunately much stronger than the responses on the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: left side of the MFR image, which are vessel.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Therefore, applying a single global threshold does not

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: provide adequate classification, as shown in Figure 2.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We propose a novel method to segment blood

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vessels that compliments local vessel attributes with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: region-based attributes of the network structure. A

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: piece of the blood vessel network is hypothesized by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: probing an area of the MFR image, iteratively

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: decreasing the threshold. At each iteration, region-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: based attributes of the piece are tested to consider

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: probe continuation, and ultimately to decide if the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: piece is vessel. Pixels from probes that are not

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: classified as vessel are recycled for further probing.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The strength of this approach is that individual pixel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: labels are decided using local and region-based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: properties.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: RELATED WORK

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Previous methods to segment blood vessels

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generally fall into three categories: window-based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Figure 1: An example retinal image with obscured vessels (left) and matched filter response (right). The response

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is coded such that a darker value represents a stronger response.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [1,2,3], classifier-based [4,5], and tracking-based [6,7].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Window-based methods, such as edge detection,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: estimate a match at each pixel for a given model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: against the pixel's surrounding window. In [1], the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cross section of a vessel in a retinal image was

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: modeled by a Gaussian shaped curve, and then

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: detected using rotated matched filters. In [2], a similar

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: method was used for artery detection in angiograms. In

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [3], a window surrounding a vessel was modeled by a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: neural network trained on user-selected examples. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: drawback of these methods is that the large-scale

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: properties of vessels (i.e., their network structure) must

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: be ignored to insure computational feasibility.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Classifier-based methods proceed in two steps.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: First, a low-level algorithm produces a segmentation of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: spatially-connected regions. These candidate regions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are then classified as being vessel or not vessel. In [4],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: regions segmented by user-assisted thresholding were

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: classified as blood vessel or leakage according to their

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: length to width ratio. In [5], regions segmented by the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: method in [1] were classified as vessel or not vessel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: according to many properties, including their response

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to a classic operator designed to detect roads in aerial

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: imagery [8]. The drawback of these methods is that the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: large-scale properties of vessels cannot be applied to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the problem until after the low-level segmentation has

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: already finished. Therefore, these properties cannot be

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: used to drive the segmentation, merely to evaluate it.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Tracking-based methods utilize a profile model to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: step along and segment a vessel incrementally. In [6], a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Hough transform is used to locate the papilla in a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: retinal image. Vessel tracing proceeds iteratively from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the papilla, halting when the response to a one-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dimensional (cross-section) matched filter falls below

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a given threshold. In [7], a similar method was

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: employed to detect vessels in coronary arteriograms,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from user-given starting points. One drawback to these

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: approaches is their proclivity for termination at branch

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: points, which are not well-modeled by one-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dimensional filters. Another drawback is their reliance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: upon unsophisticated methods for locating starting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: points.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In [9], a method for tracking edge paths is used to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segment arteries in cineangiograms. Edge paths are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: modeled as Markov chains. A sequential edge linking

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (SEL) algorithm is introduced to search the possible

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: set of paths for the best fit to the Markov model. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: probabilities of the model are adjusted to reflect the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: properties of the desired path, such as the tolerance to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: local curvature. A strength of this approach is that the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: grouping operation works upon actual gradient values,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: as opposed to a thresholded response. Therefore, a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation decision is not reached until an arbitrary

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: number of pixels is available for classification. A

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: drawback to the approach is that branches are not

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: modeled, so that each branch must be traced and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: classified independently.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this work, we propose a new method for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmenting blood vessels in a retinal image. The MFR

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image, computed as described in [1], is thresholded

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: using a novel probing technique. The probe examines

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the image in pieces, testing a number of region-based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: properties. If the probe decides a piece is vessel, then

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the constituent pixels are simultaneously segmented

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and classified. Contrasted against classifier-based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods, our probing method allows a pixel to be

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tested in multiple region configurations before final

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: classification.Contrasted against tracking-based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods, our probing method is driven by a two-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dimensional matched filter response. Contrasted

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: against [9], our probing method is region-based, and so

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: naturally allows for multiple branches.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Figure 2: Matched filter response thresholded at two different values. There is a strong overlap between true

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: positive and false positive responses.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ALGORITHM

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The basic operation of the algorithm is to probe

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: regions in a matched filter response (MFR) image.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: During each probe, a set of criteria is tested to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: determine the threshold of the probe, and ultimately to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: decide if the area being probed (termed a piece) is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: blood vessel. A flowchart for the algorithm is shown in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Figure 3. A queue of points is initialized, each of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which will be used for a probe. Upon a probe's

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: completion, if the piece is determined to be vessel,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Figure 3: Flowchart of algorithm.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: then the endpoints of the piece are added to the queue.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this way, different probes (and thusdifferent

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thresholds) can be applied throughout the image.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The following steps initialize a queue of pixels

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that are to be used as starting points for probing:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Convolve the matched filter described in [1] with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the image, producing a matched filter response

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (MFR) image.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Using a histogram of the MFR image, threshold

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the image such that > TrhREs pixels are above the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: threshold.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Thin the thresholded image (for instance, using the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: algorithm given in [10], pg. 59).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In the thinned image, erase (relabel as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: background) all branchpoints, breaking up the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: entire foreground into segments that contain two

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: endpoints each. Endpoints may be discovered as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: any pixel for which a traverse of the eight

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bordering pixels in clockwise order yields only

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: one

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: foreground-to-backgroundtransition.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Similarly, branchpoints may be discovered as any

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pixel for which the same traverse yields more than

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: two transitions.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • Discard segments with less than

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pixels.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: All remaining endpoints are placed in the probe

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: queue.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Each pixel in the probe queue is used as a starting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: point for threshold probing. The probing is iterative;

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the iterations are used to determine an appropriate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: threshold for the area being probed. The initial

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: threshold is the MFR image value at the starting pixel.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In each iteration, a region is grown from the start pixel,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: using a conditional paint-fill technique. The paint-fill

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: spreads across all connecting pixels that are not

layout_dets.label: inline_formula
layout_dets.latex: p i e c e < T _ { T R E E } ,

layout_dets.latex: T _ { M A X } = 3 5 0 0 , T _ { F R I N G E } = 0 . 3

layout_dets.label: inline_formula

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: already labeled and that are above the current

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: threshold. Once the paint-fill is complete, the desired

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: attributes of the grown region are tested. If the region

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: passes the tests, then the threshold is decreased by one,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and a new iteration begins. Each probe iteration

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: conducts the following tests:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: If the piece size (in pixels) exceeds

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: then the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: probe halts. This requires multiple pieces (and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thus potentially multiple thresholds) to segment

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the entire image. The effect is that the probe

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adapts to the local strength of the MFR image.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: If the threshold reaches zero, then the probe halts.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: This happens when probing a small area (even one

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pixel) interior to an area already classified as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vessel.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: If the piece touches (on its border) more than one

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: previously vessel-classified piece, then the probe

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: halts. This is particularly useful for bridging gaps

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: along vessels exhibiting weak MFR values.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: If the ratio border-pixels-touching-another-piece :

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: total-pixels-in-piece

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: then the piece is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fringing, and the probe halts. This prevents a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: probe from searching along the borders of vessel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pieces already segmented.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: If the piece grows a loop, then the probe halts.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Loops are detected by thinning the piece, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: counting the endpoints and branchpoints. If the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: number of endpoints exceeds the number of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: branchpoints by more than two, there is a loop.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: This test prevents a probe from searching along

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: circular MFRs, such as those caused by some

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lesions and hemorrhages.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: If the ratio total-pixels-in-piece : branches-in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: then the probe halts. This requires a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: piece to have a minimum span of vessel(s) per

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: branch, and thus prevents over-branching down

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: false paths.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Once the probe is complete, if the resulting region

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: has at least

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pixels, but less than

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pixels, then

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the region is labeled as vessel. The endpoints of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vessel piece are added to the queue. If the region is not

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: determined to be vessel, then its pixels are left

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: unlabeled. In either case, the next point in the queue is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: selected for probing. When the queue is empty, the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: algorithm is complete.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: EXPERIMENTS

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Five retinal fundus slides were selected for testing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the described method. Each slide was digitized to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: produce a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pixel image, 24-bits per pixel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (standard RGB). All five images contain abnormalities

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that obscure or confuse the blood vessel appearance.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: This selection was made for two reasons. First, most of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the referenced methods have only been demonstrated

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Figure 4: A hand-labeled segmentation of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vessels in the example image.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: upon normal vessel appearances, which are easier to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: discern. Second, some level of success with non-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: normal vessel appearances must be established to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: recommend clinical usage.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Each of these five images was carefully labeled by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hand, to produce a ground truth segmentation of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vessels. An example is shown in Figure 4. Each of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: five images was processed by the described algorithm,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: using the parameters

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: , and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: . These

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: values were selected after exploratory experiments,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: except for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which was selected as the average

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: number of pixels labeled as vessel in the ground truth

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: images. An example result is shown in Figure 5. For

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: comparison, each of the five images was globally

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thresholded using the same value of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Figure 2

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (right) shows this result for the example.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Each global-segmented result and probing-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmented result was compared against the ground

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: truth, as follows. The percentage of pixels correctly

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmented as vessel (true positive) was calculated as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the number of pixels segmented as vessel that were

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: within one pixel's distance of a pixel hand labeled as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vessel, divided by the total number of pixels hand

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: labeled as vessel. The percentage of pixels incorrectly

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmented as vessel (false positive) was calculated as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the number of pixels segmented as vessel that were not

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: within one pixel's distance of a pixel hand labeled as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vessel, divided by the total number of pixels hand

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: labeled as vessel. The tolerance of one pixel in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: distance was used to help minimize measurement

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: error. For all five images, the global-segmented result

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: had 69% sensitivity (true positive rate) and 63%

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: specificity (37% false positive rate). The probing-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmented result had 65% sensitivity and 81%

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: specificity.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: CONCLUSIONS

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The described method segments roughly two-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thirds of the vessels in a retinal fundus image.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Compared to a previously reported method [1], which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: uses only a global threshold, the proposed method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: produces roughly half the false positive responses, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a slightly decreased true positive response. The latter is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mainly attributable to the restriction upon the approach

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to produce connected vessel segmentations. A global

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: threshold is likely to segment small groups of isolated

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pixels, as in Figure 2. Although such pixels may

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: actually be correctly labeled, their utility for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: measurement is probably limited.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In order to explore our method of evaluation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: further, a second person produced an additional set of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hand-labeled ground truth for the five test images. This

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: second set of ground truth was compared to the first set

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of ground truth exactly as described above, yielding

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 80% sensitivity and 90% specificity. This suggests

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: some interesting conclusions. First, the vessels in the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: images selected for testing may in fact be too difficult

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to discern with 100% accuracy, so that our results must

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: be viewed accordingly. In contrast, our method of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: evaluation may need to be changed so that competing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hand-labeled ground truths score near perfect, thus

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: more accurately reflecting the strength of automated

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: approaches. Finally, we note that in either case there is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: still measurable room for improvement.
